events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran has led to increased tensions in the Middle East, with potential implications for global oil markets and geopolitical stability. The US and its allies have been involved in military operations in the region, and the situation remains volatile. Investors are advised to monitor the situation closely and adjust their portfolios accordingly.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation has the potential to disrupt global oil markets, leading to increased volatility in the energy sector. Investors may want to consider buying into the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) as a hedge against potential losses in emerging markets, while shorting the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF (EEM) to capitalize on potential declines in emerging market stocks.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if the conflict escalates further or if oil prices rise above $100/bbl

gains.extendedNote: If the conflict spreads to other regions
